The '''Tortali system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Tortali IV]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[XQ3 Platform]] [[Tortali Platform]]. The platform was [[Battle of Tortali IV|attacked]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
